text:
Nadia Singh: Quick flagging — our Java SDK transparent retry created duplicate invoices in sampleapp when gateway returned 429 and body was gzipped. Repro steps in CI failing flakily. Anyone seen streaming bodies + retries cause trouble?

Tom Rivera: Ouch. Do we buffer gzipped bodies or attempt to rewind streams? If not rewindable, retry will mess up. What does the SDK currently do on 429s for POSTs?

Nadia Singh: SDK retries transparently for 429/5xx up to 3 attempts with full-jitter. It replays the same request but the body is an InputStream that is consumed on first write. No Idempotency-Key being added by sampleapp.

Jin Park: Summary: two problems — (A) non-rewindable body stream, (B) unsafe transparent retries for non-idempotent writes. Proposed conservative default: do not auto-retry POST/PUT/PATCH unless either user provided Idempotency-Key OR client configured autoIdempotencyForWrites=true.

Marco Silva: For Java API parity, propose builder config: RetryPolicy policy = RetryPolicy.builder().mode(NONE|IDEMPOTENCY_KEY|ALWAYS).maxAttempts(3).strategy(FULL_JITTER).build(); Client.builder().autoIdempotencyForWrites(false).bufferBodyLimitBytes(262144).build();

Tom Rivera: Buffering note — default small-buffer (256KB) to allow safe retries of typical JSON payloads. If body > buffer limit and stream not rewindable -> throw a clear error: 'Non-rewindable body; provide Idempotency-Key or increase bufferBodyLimitBytes'.

Jin Park: Backoff snippet (we'll include in docs):
```
baseMillis = 100
capMillis = 5000
sleep = min(capMillis, baseMillis * 2**attempt)
delay = rand(0, sleep)
if (Retry-After header) delay = max(delay, parsedRetryAfterMs)
Thread.sleep(delay)
```

Nadia Singh: For sampleapp onboarding UX, let's show two toggles: naiveMode=true (no idempotency) to reproduce bug, and bestPracticeMode=true which auto-adds Idempotency-Key and enables retry.policy=IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. We should default sampleapp to bestPractice but keep naive toggles behind a dev flag for debugging.

Marco Silva: Telemetry: annotate spans with retry.attempt, retry.reason (429|5xx), idempotency.key (hashed), body.replayable=true/false. Console should show a retry chain so users can spot duplicates.

Tom Rivera: Also add classification to SDK: response.retryable boolean (true for 429 with Retry-After or 5xx; false for 4xx except 429). Let apps inspect this and implement custom logic.

Nadia Singh: CI test plan: stub gateway to return 429 first with Retry-After:0.1 then 201. Two tests: (1) with Idempotency-Key, assert single invoice created; (2) with non-rewindable gzipped body and auto retries enabled, assert SDK errors with clear message.

Jin Park: Docs checklist: header name recommendation (Idempotency-Key), server-side pseudocode (using Redis setnx + TTL), buffering guidance and default sizes, SDK config parity table across Node/Python/Java/Go, sampleapp toggles and CI tests.

Marco Silva: I'll open a small Java SDK PR implementing conservative default (no retries for writes without idempotency), bufferBodyLimitBytes, and clear error for non-rewindable streams. Will add unit tests and an integration test for sampleapp.

QA Bot: automated test scheduled: devex/retries/idempotency/java CI job added. It will fail until PR lands.

Nadia Singh: Thanks — please tag me on PRs. Let's ship conservative defaults to avoid more duplicate side-effects in onboarding. Closing thread.
